yaml:
scenario: Febrile_Neutropenia_Detection
version: "1.0.0"
description: "Detect febrile neutropenia based on absolute neutrophil count and temperature criteria"

signals:
  ANC:
    ref: absolute_neutrophil_count
    expected_unit: cells/uL
    description: "Absolute neutrophil count"
  Temp:
    ref: body_temperature
    expected_unit: C
    description: "Body temperature"

trends:
  temp_current:
    expr: last(Temp)
    description: "Current temperature"
  temp_sustained:
    expr: sma(Temp, 1h)
    description: "Sustained temperature over the last hour"

logic:
  neutropenia:
    when: ANC < 500
    severity: critical
    description: "Absolute neutrophil count below 500 cells/uL"
  fever:
    when: temp_current >= 38.3 OR temp_sustained >= 38.0
    severity: critical
    description: "Single oral temperature of 38.3C or higher (or 38.0C sustained for an hour)"
  febrile_neutropenia:
    when: neutropenia AND fever
    severity: critical
    description: "Febrile neutropenia detected"

outputs:
  decision:
    has_febrile_neutropenia:
      type: boolean
      from: febrile_neutropenia
      description: "Patient has febrile neutropenia"
  features:
    neutrophil_count:
      type: float
      from: ANC
      description: "Current absolute neutrophil count"
    temperature:
      type: float
      from: temp_current
      description: "Current body temperature"
  evidence:
    timestamp:
      type: datetime
      expr: evaluation_time()
      description: "When this evaluation was performed"
errors: PSDL Parse Error: Validation errors: Logic 'neutropenia' references unknown term 'ANC'
